title: Avalanche Cycles Stainless Steel Quatre Stem
content:
Since Avalanche Cycles first debuted its “Quatre” stem on a custom bike, fans of the Parisian framebuilding shop have been asking for it. Unveiled at 2026 Bespoked Dresden, Avalanche Cycles is selling its “Quatre” stainless steel stem, ready to be installed on your bike. It’s being offered in a “brushed stainless steel” finish, revealing attractive silver soldering and ensuring it pairs perfectly with your bike, without compromising on style.

For this first batch, it’s being offered it in a 90 mm length to fit the highest number of potential riders.

Each stem is handmade by Marie herself in Avalanche’s Parisian workshop.

Check them out at Avalanche Cycles.
